lines: The tower's records… I filled in half a page. 'The weakest refused strength.'
Was the prophecy wrong? No — it was read wrong.
The Black Flame feeds on ambition. Wheatear's handwriting is… truer than the canon.
The folk version says the first weakest one entered the tower. The official version cut that second half.
Meager Edge? If Ding still recognises iron, the world isn't finished.
Behind the archive door: three theories of the Black Flame, the order of disbandment, and a torn-out page about 'the weakest'.
A rabbit? Few come looking for books. Many come looking for excuses.
The prophecy says 'the weakest shall reach the tower'. Don't be so quick to see yourself in it — read as far as the contradictions first.
